author: Inside Edition
description: A plane making an emergency landing on a Florida highway clipped a truck as it came down. Danny Roldan recorded the incident on his phone. Everyone survived, and volunteers and rescue workers pushed the Cessna from the roadway. In a separate incident over the weekend, a pilot was rescued after making an emergency landing of a plane in a mangrove. These two mishaps come just a week after the deadly plane crash that left nine people dead in Palm Beach.
title: Plane Makes Emergency Landing On Florida Highway

author: Inside Edition
description: President Donald Trump appeared to choose his pal, UFC boss Dana White, to be his new press secretary. The president posted an AI-generated cartoon of White holding a press briefing with his fighters beating up reporters. White also posted a photo to social media, with a message that read "on to the next chapter." Later, Trump claimed he was joking. Meanwhile, "Saturday Night Live" also made jokes, poking fun at the midterm election results.
title: Trump Says Selecting UFC CEO Dana White For Press Secretary Was A Joke

author: Inside Edition
description: Guitar virtuoso Richard Lloyd has passed away. He was part of the iconic band Television, which he cofounded in the 1970s with Tom Verlaine. Lloyd had been in and out of the hospital, battling cholangiocarcinoma, a rare bile duct cancer. In his final interview, he and his wife Sheila spoke to Inside Edition Digital about his health.
title: Influential Television Guitarist Richard Lloyd Dies at 75

author: Inside Edition
description: Firefighters arrived at a blazing Connecticut apartment building to find a desperate situation. One woman did not want to leave, because her sister with emphysema was trapped in their downstairs apartment. A police officer raced down the stairs and found 69-year-old Charline Fletcher as the apartment filled with smoke and flames. The officer scooped her up and carried her to safety. Inside Edition spoke with the sisters, Charline and her 71-year-old sister, Michelle.
title: Woman Makes Plea To Officer To Save Her Sister From Apartment Fire

author: Inside Edition
description: Disgraced English comedian Russell Brand was sentenced to ten and a half years in prison, after being found guilty of raping a woman and sexually assaulting three others. Brand doesn't appear to be adjusting well to confinement. He is said to be cowering in fear of his fellow inmates, who have reportedly been taunting him behind bars. Brand's wife is reportedly moving with their three young children from their home in Florida to the United Kingdom to be close to the prison.
title: Russell Brand Sentenced To 10 And Half Years In Prison

author: Inside Edition
description: NVIDIA has initiated an independent investigation involving its co-founder and CEO, Jensen Huang, following claims that he may have been targeted by a Chinese intelligence operation while having an affair. The allegations involve a Chinese businesswoman named Alice Huang, who U.S. intelligence officials suspect may have connections to China's Ministry of State Security, the nation's primary intelligence agency, according to CBS News. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: NVIDIA Investigates CEO's Affair With Woman Suspected Of Being A Chinese Spy

author: Inside Edition
description: A man walking through his city was knocked down when a runaway wheel came out of nowhere and struck him. Witnesses rushed to check on him and offer help. The odd incident was caught by municipal cameras in Santiago, Chile. Reports say the wheel detached from a vehicle and hit two other cars before striking the 19-year-old pedestrian.
title: Runaway Wheel Knocks Over Pedestrian #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: President Trump tells 60 Minutes he doesn't believe he'll be impeached for a third time. In a wide-ranging interview following an unfavorable midterm election outcome, the president was asked about what the final two years of his term will look like having to work with a Democratic-led congress. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Trump Doesn't See A 3rd Impeachment By Next Congress: 'What Have I Done?'

author: Inside Edition
description: Former President Joe Biden says he's been writing a book about his time as Commander in Chief. "Promise Me, America" details the decisions he made while leading the country, but Biden just announced on social media that the tour to promote his book won't be very robust. The 46th president of the United States announced last year that he had stage 4, metastatic prostate cancer. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Joe Biden's Cancer Treatments Will Limit Book Tour Appearances
